decisions.reason: As the firm’s flagship GIS platform and a core vehicle for its strategic direction, it is closely tied to existing capabilities and standards-based enterprise work, so the option value of keeping it is high and the evidence does not justify abandonment.

Mobile field data capture fits the firm’s established geospatial solutions and customer base, and while ongoing maintenance may be meaningful, uncertainty about future project demand still makes retaining it more attractive than dropping it.

The search extension is a close-to-core add-on with relatively low carrying costs and recent evidence of active versioning, so under real options logic it is worth keeping unless clearer signs of weak value emerge.
